# agent-device 0.20.8 refresh handoff

## Acceptance target

capture per case:

- platforms: iOS and Android;
- models: GPT mini low (`gpt_low`) and Haiku low (`haiku_low`);
- apps: Bluesky and Element;
- tasks: all 30 tasks for each app/platform/model combination.

separate; never combine Android captures with iOS captures under one score. Each platform batch must
be serial and resumable. iOS and Android may run concurrently only when they use their own simulator
or emulator, state directories, service ports, process registries, and result roots.

The committed iOS and Android wrappers each execute their own 120-case portion. Captures and judging
are kept in separate `data/` and `android-data/` roots. Website publication still needs a platform
selector after the new Android results exist; do not merge the two result roots into one implicit
aggregate.

## One-time prerequisites

- Global `agent-device` must report `0.20.8`.
- The installed public skills must exist at `~/.agents/skills/{agent-device,ios-simulator,android-emulator}`.
- `bench-golden-v4` must remain Shutdown. It has been clone-verified to contain Bluesky 1.122.0 and
  Element. `configs/golden.json` selects it by name.
- OpenCode auth must contain `openai` and `vercel` credentials. As a fallback, Haiku accepts
  `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` from an env file passed through `BENCH_ENV_FILE`.
- The wrapper starts Bluesky's deterministic dev-env backend (including throwaway PostgreSQL and
  Redis) when `:1987` is down. Synapse must answer on `:8008` when Element is selected. `doctor.py`
  fails before API spend if either reset surface is absent.
- Other simulators may remain booted. Their names are recorded in each run's `env.json` because
  shared CoreSimulator/host load can affect timing, but explicit UDID scoping preserves correctness.
- The wrapper forces `BENCH_KILL_SCOPE=owned` and creates a new process-ownership registry for this
  invocation. It terminates only the OpenCode/proxy/agent-device processes it starts; pre-existing
  daemons and other worktrees are reported and left untouched.
- The benchmark contains no simulator-deletion path. Each case creates a fresh clone for state
  isolation and shuts it down afterward, leaving it available for inspection. Expect
  at least 120 preserved `bench-ad0208-*` clones (plus outlier retries) and ensure sufficient disk space.
  Cleanup is deliberately outside this handoff and requires a separate explicit decision.
- Every run gets a temporary `AGENT_DEVICE_STATE_DIR`, so it cannot reuse or disturb the global
  packaged daemon even when other worktrees have agent-device processes.

## Run

### iOS — ready

```bash
cd benchmarks
APPS=bluesky,element ./run_agent_device_0208.sh
```

Policy implemented by the runner:

1. Run every stale/missing selected case once. A result is stale when its harness, app version,
   agent-device version, installed skill hashes, or model route differs.
2. Judge the selected cells and rebuild `public/` and report data through the website build.

Worker instruction — this is deliberately **not automated by benchmark code**: after each platform's
one-pass GPT + Haiku run, inspect `meta.json.wall_s`. For every case above 200 seconds, rerun that
exact platform/model/app/task case up to two additional times. Preserve every capture before a forced
rerun and retain the valid capture with the smallest `wall_s` among the original and repeats. Then
rerun that platform's judge and website build so the published result reflects the chosen capture.
Do not rerun cases at or below 200 seconds, and do not substitute a repeat from another platform,
model, app, or earlier agent-device version.

For a resumable iOS slice when one app service is temporarily unavailable:

```bash
APPS=bluesky ./run_agent_device_0208.sh
# later, after restoring Synapse:
APPS=element ./run_agent_device_0208.sh
```

Do not call the iOS refresh complete until both slices finish. If an intermediate website is built,
label the refreshed slice and platform explicitly; untouched members remain 0.17.6 and must not be
represented as part of an aggregate 0.20.8 result.

### Android — capture and judging ready

The Android wrapper restores the authenticated `app-control-bench-golden` AVD snapshot before every
case, reseeds the matching service, restores adb reverse ports, stages the same 0.20.8 skills, and
writes only to `android-data/`:

```bash
cd benchmarks
BENCH_ANDROID_SYNAPSE_REGISTER_BIN=/private/tmp/app-control-bench-synapse-venv/bin/register_new_matrix_user \
  ./run_agent_device_0208_android.sh
```

Run all 120 Android cases once (`gpt_low,haiku_low` × Bluesky,Element × 30), perform the same manual
slow-case repeats, and judge them. The worker must not build the website from Android data until the
platform selector/export path is committed; that publication change is a follow-up over real results,
not a reason to mix Android runs into the iOS cells.

`PREFLIGHT_ONLY=1` is a no-spend surface check. It validates both provider credentials, the exact
three installed skills, `agent-device doctor --platform android`, the saved golden, installed app
packages, and both local services. It deliberately does not foreground authenticated apps: Bluesky's
refresh token rotates on use, so consuming the frozen snapshot token in preflight invalidates the
immediately following restore. Each paid case performs reset, port restoration, and authenticated
app readiness before invoking the model; a readiness failure records a setup error without API spend.

## Comparison baseline

The checked-in GPT-high agent-device cell records 0.20.6; the other three cells, including both
low-effort cells targeted by this refresh, record 0.17.6. The low-effort cells currently measure as
follows; time is the mean over all 60 or 30 runs, matching the headline report:

| Model | Scope | agent-device | argent | agent-device time |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GPT mini low | all 60 | 82.5% | 82.5% | 80.2s |
| GPT mini low | Bluesky 30 | 80.0% | 88.3% | 101.8s |
| GPT mini low | Element 30 | 85.0% | 76.7% | 58.6s |
| Haiku low | all 60 | 84.2% | 94.2% | 141.9s |
| Haiku low | Bluesky 30 | 86.7% | 100.0% | 179.9s |
| Haiku low | Element 30 | 81.7% | 88.3% | 104.0s |

slice alone, GPT needs 3 task-points and Haiku 1. A success is 1 point and a partial is 0.5.

capture cost (#1587), Bluesky-class AX-hostile targeting and text entry (#1588), the iOS text-entry
runner wedge (#1604), hidden-keyboard responder entry and commit observation (#1657/#1676), collapsed
app-driving startup turns (#1693), and faster sparse-tree recovery (#1700). Do not attribute gains to
one change without case evidence, but these fixes cover several observed baseline failure classes.

## Existing unpublished artifacts — do not merge into the 0.20.8 cells

- The website PR publishes the comparable 0.20.6 GPT-high iOS batch: 60 judged Bluesky + Element
  tasks, 91.7% overall (95.0% Bluesky, 88.3% Element), 113.9s mean wall time after the instructed
  fastest-valid outlier selection. Its staged source is
  `/private/tmp/app-control-bench-0206-judge/gpt_high__agent-device/`.
- A later complete 0.20.6 iOS capture tree exists at
  `/private/tmp/app-control-bench.73Cnas/repo/data/gpt_high__agent-device/`: 60/60 captures returned
  zero, but they are unjudged, average 142.7s, and include experimental prompt/help controls. Do not
  promote them over the comparable batch or use them as 0.20.8 intermediates.
- A complete judged 0.20.6 Android Bluesky extension exists at
  `/private/tmp/app-control-bench.73Cnas/repo/android-data/gpt_high__agent-device/`: 28 success / 2
  fail (93.3%), 115.6s mean wall time. It used the separate `android-pilot-v1` harness and is not an
  iOS cell. Publishing it requires adding an Android dimension to the report and carrying over the
  uncommitted Android harness/task-fixture work from that checkout.
- `/private/tmp/app-control-bench.73Cnas/android-data-rerun-20260809-clean/` is only an incoherent
  intermediate: 11 valid captures plus setup-failure records across a server reseed. Do not publish
  it. The later bsky-06/bsky-09/element-06 help experiments nearby are diagnostic A/B samples, not
  benchmark cells.

There are intentionally no recorded 0.20.8 benchmark results yet: producing those 240 first-pass
captures is the worker's job, not a setup prerequisite. A worker must write new results through the
wrappers above rather than selecting any of these 0.20.6 artifacts.

## Current machine readiness (verified 2026-08-12)

- The exact iOS preflight passes for `gpt_low,haiku_low` and `bluesky,element`: OpenCode has both

The 120-case iOS portion is ready for a paid worker run. The Android capture/judge portion is also
